facts.summary: tools/loadcheck/loadcheck.c would cover this set after one edit: its hard-coded modules[] list names the 1.2.8 files (Win32Craft.1.2.8-arm32.exe, win32craft.dll, fmod_ARM.dll, ucrtbase.dll, vccorlib140.dll, msvcp140.dll, concrt140.dll, vcruntime140.dll). For 0.10.4 use {Win32Craft.0.10.4-arm32.exe, win32craft.dll, vccorlib120_app.dll, msvcp120_app.dll, msvcr120_app.dll, ucrtbase.dll}. What it already does right: parses each module import table, LoadLibraryEx every imported DLL with the folder as DLL directory (this also runs the three VC120 DllMains, and the loader itself rejects an APPCONTAINER-flagged or bad-machine DLL here), GetProcAddress every name AND ordinal (XAudio2_8 #1, WS2_32 ordinals), reports which file served each api-set name. Gaps: (1) a missing module file is only "skipped" (false OK if the exe was renamed) - make it a failure; (2) it does not map the patched exe itself, so a bad section table/APPCONTAINER on the EXE is not detected (optional: LoadLibraryExW(exe, DONT_RESOLVE_DLL_REFERENCES) - untested idea); (3) no delay-import walk needed here (exe has none); (4) it cannot see runtime GetProcAddress/LoadLibrary calls by the host or game.
facts.x86_to_arm_notes: Run loadcheck on the RT before any game run; its answer for the 8 unproven contracts decides whether shims are needed.

facts.summary: Other redirect points on the same chain (all verified): sub_203EFC (empty frame, tail b.w to sub_20405C); sub_20405C main wrapper calls bl sub_1F42A4 "user main(Array<String^>^)" at 0x2040C6; sub_1F42A4 builds the ApplicationInitializationCallback delegate (bl sub_1EA914 at 0x1F42C6) and calls bl sub_1EECBC at 0x1F42CE; sub_1EECBC = Application::Start: GetActivationFactory(L"Windows.UI.Xaml.Application", IID {06499997-F7B4-45FE-B763-7577D1D3CB4A} = IApplicationStatics) via sub_2001E4 at 0x1EED1A, then virtual call vtbl+0x1C (slot 7 = Start) with r1 = the callback at 0x1EED30. Therefore architecture (b) needs NO extra exe patch: keep the call-site redirect, let the host install the IAT hooks, activate a fake "Windows.UI.Xaml.Application" statics object whose slot 7 runs the callback, and (if the original flow is wanted) call image+0x203EFC|1 from Win32Bootstrap to continue into the unmodified main wrapper. Architecture (a) (friend) simply never calls it.
facts.arm_signature: int sub_203EFC(void) /* args ignored, returns exit code; tail-calls sub_20405C */
facts.x86_to_arm_notes: The host bootstrap is a normal C function; calling the original main wrapper from it needs ARM_CODE(image,0x203EFC) (Thumb bit) and ignores arguments.
